problem_statement: technext/ThemeBlog is a static, fully responsive Bootstrap editorial blog template (Theme Blog) served directly as flat HTML: a shared fixed top navigation bar sits above a home article feed of ten posts, each rendered as an <article class="blog-item"> card with a local thumbnail (assets/img/*.jpg), a category line, and an <h1> headline, closed by a shared footer; interior pages (Design Inspiration, Toolkits) reuse the same shared chrome. Grow the home feed into a small design-system browse experience with TWO shared components. (1) A 'Browse the feed' category filter (a .feedfilter panel with a .feedfilter__chips row of chips — All posts / Corporate / Event / Restaurant / Photography / Launch — and a .feedfilter__readout line) placed directly above the article feed: clicking a chip filters the .blog-item cards to that template category and updates the readout to 'Showing N of 10 · <label>', and re-selecting All posts restores all ten. Each article carries a data-post-cat tag matching its real template subject, so the filter is grounded in the actual posts. (2) A shared cross-page 'Reading path' rail (a .readpath-rail with .readpath-rail__step links to Latest feed / Design Inspiration / Toolkits) declared in one shared registry (assets/js/readpath.js) so the SAME rail renders on the Home feed, the Design Inspiration page, and the Toolkits page. Keep the existing masthead, feed, interior pages, local image assets, and footer intact. Do not ship a divergent bespoke control that only recolors or that renders the filter/rail on some pages but not others.
required_content: The home feed shows a 'Browse the feed' category filter (.feedfilter) directly above the article feed with a chip row (All posts, Corporate, Event, Restaurant, Photography, Launch) and a 'Showing N of 10' readout.
Clicking the Corporate chip filters the .blog-item cards to the Corporate posts and updates the readout to 'Showing 2 of 10 · Corporate'; re-selecting All posts restores all ten.
Each of the ten articles carries a data-post-cat category grounded in its real template subject (corporate/event/restaurant/photography/launch).
A shared cross-page 'Reading path' rail (.readpath-rail with .readpath-rail__step links) renders on the Home feed, the Design Inspiration page, and the Toolkits page from a single shared registry.
The filter chips and the reading-path rail wrap cleanly with no horizontal overflow at 834px tablet and 390px mobile, and the active chip and readout stay legible.
The existing masthead, ten-post feed, interior pages, local image assets, and footer remain intact and reachable.
design_constraints: Filter the actual .blog-item feed and keep the .feedfilter__readout count in lockstep with the visible cards; do not snapshot a frozen readout that ignores the selected category.
Render the reading-path rail on every whitelisted page (Home, Design Inspiration, Toolkits) from the shared registry; do not ship it on only some pages.
Keep the filter chips and rail steps in a fluid wrapping row; do not use a fixed over-wide non-wrapping strip that overflows narrow viewports.
Keep the active chip and readout high-contrast and legible; do not collapse the panel into an illegible dark-on-dark or overlapping strip.
Use the existing local image assets (assets/img/*.jpg) and the current HTML/Bootstrap/jQuery structure; do not introduce a framework or external stock imagery.
Preserve the existing feed content, interior pages, and footer; the browse controls are additive.
state_constraints: desktop_home / mobile_home / tablet_home capture the existing Theme Blog article feed with the shared fixed top-nav and footer, the 'Browse the feed' filter above the feed, and the shared reading-path rail.

desktop_feed_filter / mobile_feed_filter scroll the .feedfilter panel into view; the chip row wraps cleanly with no horizontal overflow and the readout reads 'Showing 10 of 10 · All posts' before any click.
desktop_corporate_filter clicks the Corporate chip: the feed filters to the Corporate posts and the readout becomes 'Showing 2 of 10 · Corporate'.
desktop_design_inspiration and desktop_toolkits capture the interior pages, each showing the SAME shared reading-path rail (readpath-rail__step links) rendered from the shared registry.

In a lacking submission the filter row is a fixed over-wide non-wrapping strip that overflows mobile and the reading-path rail is registered on the home page only (absent from Design Inspiration and Toolkits), though the filter click still updates the readout correctly.

In an off-system submission the filter panel collapses into an illegible dark-on-dark overlapping strip and the Corporate click leaves a frozen 'Showing 10 of 10 · All posts' readout without filtering the feed.

change_completion: The 'Browse the feed' category filter renders above the home article feed with the full chip row and a 'Showing N of 10' readout.
Clicking Corporate filters the feed to the Corporate posts and updates the readout to 'Showing 2 of 10 · Corporate'.
The shared reading-path rail renders on Home, Design Inspiration, and Toolkits from one registry.
Every article carries a data-post-cat category grounded in its real template subject.
design_consistency: The filter panel and reading-path rail reuse the site's editorial red/white visual language and shared chrome rather than a divergent bespoke control.
The active chip and readout stay high-contrast and legible; chips and rail steps are evenly spaced, not overlapping or clipped.
The reading-path rail is present on every page it should appear on, driven by the shared registry.
regression: The existing ten-post feed, interior pages, local images, and footer remain intact and reachable.
The static server can still serve the repo without a framework dev server.
responsive: 390px mobile and 834px tablet Home have no horizontal overflow and the filter chips remain tappable.
The filter chips and rail steps wrap cleanly on narrow viewports without an over-wide non-wrapping strip.

author_notes: Product-grade Consistency (content_asset_continuity) task on the static Bootstrap ThemeBlog editorial blog. The native lever is the home article feed's OWN category filter (.feedfilter 'Browse the feed') that filters the .blog-item cards and a 'Showing N of 10' readout, plus a shared cross-page reading-path rail (.readpath-rail) driven by a single registry. Reference wires the filter correctly, wraps the chips fluidly, and renders the rail on Home + Design Inspiration + Toolkits. The lacking submission (baseline) keeps the filter wiring correct but lays the chip row out as a fixed over-wide non-wrapping strip that overflows mobile and only registers the rail on the home page. The off-system submission (bad) collapses the panel into an illegible dark-on-dark overlapping strip and freezes the readout at 'Showing 10 of 10 · All posts' after the Corporate click without filtering. Discriminators: no_horizontal_overflow (tol 24, mobile), visual_regression (pixelmatch+ssim+block_fidelity on the filter panel), cross-PAGE dom_assertions (readpath-rail__step on Home/Design Inspiration/Toolkits), and interaction_assertions (post-click readout 'Showing 2 of 10'). The Bootstrap collapse hides the top-nav below 768px, so the cross-page rail assertions are asserted on desktop; mobile is covered by the filter overflow states.
